body.id: Satu tulisan baru ditambahkan ke blog: "Kala Raksasa GPU Diduga Mengatur Pasokan Sendiri". Tulisannya membahas sorotan regulator terhadap dugaan putaran modal nvidia dan dampaknya bagi pengembang peranti lunak di indonesia Artikel terbaru: "Melihat Angka 600 Token per Detik: Antara Kebutuhan dan Hype".
body.en: A new article was added to the blog: "When a GPU Titan Reportedly Engineers Its Own Shortage". It covers antitrust investigations into circular ai venture funding and why global hardware bottlenecks matter to developers everywhere Latest article: "Serving Massive AI Models at Scale: Beyond the Benchmark Noise".
